resources.string: You haven\'t logged an Active Day yet this week.
Tracking lost. Step back into frame.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, weight in your heels, chest up.

string-array.name: form_guide_squat_cues
string-array.item: Push your hips back like sitting into a chair
Keep your knees tracking over your toes
Drive through your heels to stand back up

string-array.name: form_guide_squat_mistakes
string-array.item: Knees caving inward
Rounding the lower back
Heels lifting off the ground

resources.string: Tracks the angle at your knee to judge how deep you squat and how consistently you return to standing.
Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.

string-array.name: form_guide_push_up_cues
string-array.item: Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows at about 45°
Keep your core tight so your hips don\'t sag
Push back up to a full arm extension

string-array.name: form_guide_push_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips sagging or piking up
Flaring elbows straight out to the sides
Not lowering far enough to count as a full rep

resources.string: Tracks the angle at your elbow to judge how far you lower and how fully you press back up.
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands lightly behind your head or crossed on your chest.

string-array.name: form_guide_sit_up_cues
string-array.item: Curl your torso up leading with your chest, not your neck
Keep your feet flat on the floor throughout
Lower back down under control

string-array.name: form_guide_sit_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Yanking on your neck with your hands
Using momentum instead of your core
Feet lifting off the floor

resources.string: Tracks the angle at your hip to judge how far you curl up and how far you return down.

string-array.name: form_guide_lunge_cues
string-array.item: Step forward and lower until both knees are close to 90°
Keep your front knee over your ankle, not past your toes
Push back through your front heel to return to standing

string-array.name: form_guide_lunge_mistakes
string-array.item: Front knee collapsing inward
Leaning the torso too far forward
Back knee slamming into the floor

resources.string: Tracks the angle at your front knee to judge how deep each lunge goes and how consistently you return to standing.
Stand tall with feet together, arms at your sides.

string-array.name: form_guide_jumping_jack_cues
string-array.item: Jump your feet out while raising your arms overhead
Keep the movement quick and rhythmic
Jump back to the starting position to complete the rep

string-array.name: form_guide_jumping_jack_mistakes
string-array.item: Arms not reaching overhead
Feet barely leaving the ground
Losing rhythm between reps

resources.string: Tracks the angle at your shoulder to judge how high your arms swing on each rep.
Stand tall with feet together, arms at your sides — same as Jumping Jack, without the jump.

string-array.name: form_guide_step_jack_cues
string-array.item: Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead
Step back to the middle to complete the rep
Alternate sides at a steady, controlled pace

string-array.name: form_guide_step_jack_mistakes
string-array.item: Shifting weight without actually stepping the foot out
Arms not raising enough to register
Rushing the step-together return

resources.string: Tracks the angle at your shoulder just like Jumping Jack, but counts a rep at a lower arm-raise angle to match the lower-impact movement.
